reasoning_content:
`just ls` reported "No Urbo instances running" but `docker ps` shows running containers. The label likely didn't get applied because URBO_INSTANCE env... but wait, the containers were created with the instance label. Let me check the labels.

Actually the docker ps filter uses label io.swcode.urbo.instance. Let me check.

action.command: docker ps --filter 'label=io.swcode.urbo.instance' --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Label "io.swcode.urbo.instance"}}\t{{.Service}}' | head; echo "---all labels on one---"; docker inspect urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 --format '{{json .Config.Labels}}' | head -c 500
